children: Tenon Medical executed a warrant exercise inducement that generated approximately $2.87 million in gross proceeds as an existing holder exercised Series A warrants at $5.02 per share. In connection, the company will issue 858,269 unregistered Series B warrants at the same $5.02 exercise price, exercisable for five years. Tenon plans to use the net proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes and will file a resale registration statement within 30 days, targeting effectiveness within 60 to 90 days. The company also engaged WallachBeth Capital as financial advisor, agreeing to a 7% fee on gross proceeds and up to $65,000 in legal expense reimbursement.
